name: Together AI GPU Clusters (HGX H100, on-demand)
region: not stated on the pricing page
price_basis: per GPU-hour - the page states 'All prices per gpu per hour'. On-demand pay-as-you-go: NVIDIA HGX H100 $5.49; HGX B200 $8.99. H200, B300, GB200 NVL72 and GB300 NVL72 are 'Contact us' on-demand. Every Reserved tier is 'Contact sales'. Fetched 2026-10-03.
notes: A NARROW RECORD BY DESIGN: Together publishes exactly one number, $5.49 per H100-hour, and gates everything else - H200, B300, GB200, GB300, and every reservation - behind a sales conversation. Recording it is still worth it because $5.49 lands in the interesting middle band: cheaper than every hyperscaler on-demand H100 (AWS $6.88, GCP $11.06, Azure $12.29), dearer than Runpod's in-stock $3.49 and Lambda's $3.99. It is also the only provider here whose headline H100 number is not undercut by a cheaper in-stock alternative, which makes it a candidate if you want a managed inference platform with the GPUs attached rather than bare compute. Do NOT confuse this with Together's per-token serverless prices on the same page - those are a different unit entirely and are not a supply figure. They have also announced on-demand B200s on GPU Clusters, which the $8.99 reflects.
